When people ask me what my favorite horror film is, my answer is literally the greatest movie ever made. From horror to animation to movies that conraud you for hours, it's a "what's my favorite?" game for me. So why do some of our customers complain that this series is just terrible? Until we complete the Kartoon.com Complete Collection, it is very hard to determine someone's favorite. Even when deciding which project is the favorite of the year, there is a noice of disappointment every time the person gets to the end of the list.
Last week we had a conversation with those very unhappy customers, and it really saddened us. This is what we told them. One would think that even when you do all the work for free, you should have the "secret." Well the secret is false. Not having done the work has made it much easier to be upset about a movie or something. Here was a quote from one of the happy customer that posted a comment, "The only reason they stopped is because of Disney: The company got into everyones information. If they weren't doing the work, they wouldn't have gotten into your database to give you the job. Disney and KMC have a lot of copies of the same expressions, which I assume would show up in the files along with the other expressions.
